definitions.explanation: Being connected to or part of a larger organization or institution.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}{附属|ふぞく}{病院|びょういん}で{治療|ちりょう}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received treatment at the university-affiliated hospital.

examples.japanese: この{学校|がっこう}は{国立|こくりつ}{大学|だいがく}の{附属|ふぞく}です。
examples.english: This school is affiliated with a national university.

examples.japanese: {附属|ふぞく}{書類|しょるい}を{確認|かくにん}してください。

notes:
{附属|ふぞく} indicates that something is attached to or affiliated with a larger organization.

Alternate kanji spelling:
- {付属|ふぞく} (more commonly used today)

Common usage:
- [organization]{附属|ふぞく}[institution] - [institution] affiliated with [organization]
- {大学|だいがく}{附属|ふぞく}{高校|こうこう} (university-affiliated high school)
- {附属|ふぞく}{病院|びょういん} (teaching hospital, affiliated hospital)
- {附属|ふぞく}品 (accessories, attachments)

The pattern [noun]の{附属|ふぞく} or {附属|ふぞく}の[noun] both work.
